SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.EdOpsName = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT frpm.CDSCode
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` + frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

SELECT schools.District
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY schools.District
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND schools.County = 'Alameda' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT schools.School, schools.CharterNum
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T1.sname, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.FundingType HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.sname) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND s.GSserved = '9-12';

WITH locally_funded AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.DOC, s.DOCType,
         f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS diff,
         AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) OVER () AS avg_diff
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT School, DOC, DOCType
FROM locally_funded
WHERE diff > avg_diff;

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT F.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / F.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm F
JOIN schools S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode
WHERE (S.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND S.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (S.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND S.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (S.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND S.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = '1'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'
  AND T2.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.MailStreet, s.School
FROM satscores AS st
JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson'
  AND AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez';
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT s.County
FROM schools s
WHERE s.SOC = 11
  AND s.ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
GROUP BY s.County
ORDER BY COUNT(s.CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s."School", f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND f."High Grade" = '9'

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f."Low Grade", s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T2 JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8' AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT frpm.`District Code`, frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR schools.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2, s.AdmEmail3
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND s.SOC = 62
  AND s.DOC = 54;

FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT p.Title FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount)

SELECT u.DisplayName

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id)
FROM users u
JOIN badges b1 ON b1.UserId = u.Id AND (b1.Name = 'Teachers' OR b1.Name = 'Teacher')
JOIN badges b2 ON b2.UserId = u.Id AND b2.Name = 'Supporter'

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName, u.Views
HAVING u.Views >= 1000

SELECT u.DisplayName, b.Name
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id

LIMIT 1

SELECT ph.PostHistoryTypeId, COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) AS UniqueCommenters
FROM postHistory ph
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = ph.PostId
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720
GROUP BY ph.PostHistoryTypeId;

SELECT p.Score, pl.LinkTypeId
FROM posts p
JOIN postLinks pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(u.UpVotes) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_up_votes,
       SUM(u.Age) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id
HAVING COUNT(p.OwnerUserId) > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT users.Id)
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE badges.Name = 'Announcer';

SELECT b.Date
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'Rochester, NY';
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE CreationDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0');

SELECT DISTINCT users.Age
FROM users
JOIN badges ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010;
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 THEN 1 END) FROM votes;
SELECT DISTINCT posts.Tags FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.DisplayName
ORDER BY SUM(p.ViewCount) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges AS b
JOIN users AS u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Commentator'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', b.Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE posts.CreationDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2010-07-21 23:59:59';
SELECT DisplayName, Age FROM users WHERE Views IN (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users);

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT T2.DisplayName, T2.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.FavoriteCount > 150

SELECT p.Id, COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount, p.LastEditDate
FROM posts p
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY p.Id, p.LastEditDate;

SELECT u.LastAccessDate, u.Location
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT DISTINCT p.Id, b.Name
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = c.UserId
WHERE c.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND YEAR(c.CreationDate) = 2013
  AND YEAR(b.Date) = 2013;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000

SELECT p.OwnerUserId
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Age ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate)
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Reputation IN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users);

SELECT COUNT(p.Id)
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens'
  AND YEAR(p.CreaionDate) = 2010;

SELECT p.Id, p.Title, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
ORDER BY p.Score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000
  AND YEAR(p.CreaionDate) = 2011;

SELECT COUNT(p.Id)
FROM posts p
JOIN (SELECT AVG(ViewCount) AS avg_views FROM posts) a
  ON p.ViewCount > a.avg_views;
SELECT COUNT(c.Id) FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM posts)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id)
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 35000 AND p.CommentCount = 0;

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Emmett'
ORDER BY b.Date DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 AND UpVotes > 5000

SELECT b.Date - u.CreationDate AS TimeToBadge
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Zolomon';

SELECT c.Text, u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(posts.Id)
FROM posts
JOIN tags ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.TagName = 'careers';

SELECT Reputation, Views
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon'

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.Id) AS comment_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.Id) AS answer_count
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN posts a ON a.ParentId = p.Id AND a.PostTypeId = 2
WHERE p.Title = 'Clustering 1D data';

SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE Score > 50 AND OwnerUserId IN (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users))) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IN (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)));
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Id < 15 AND Count <= 20

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%linear regression%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT users.Id)
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Score = 0
  AND users.Age = 40;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(c.UserId) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
  AND T2.Consumption < 30000;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = 201310
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(y.Consumption)
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND y.Date = '201305';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'Euro' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM customers c
JOIN customers c2 ON c2.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM';
SELECT MAX(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE y.Date LIKE '2012%'

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) FROM (SELECT SUM(Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Currency = 'Euro') GROUP BY CustomerID) AS t

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) = '09';

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE SUBSTR(t.Date, 1, 6) = '201306';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT t.CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY t.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
ORDER BY y.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT SUM(T1.Amount * T1.Price) AS TotalSpent
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.CustomerID = '38508' AND T2.Date = '201201';

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT P.player_api_id
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, p.height
FROM Player p
LEFT JOIN Player taller ON taller.height > p.height
WHERE taller.id IS NULL;
SELECT T1.preferred_foot FROM Player AS T2 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id ORDER BY T1.potential ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT P.player_api_id, MAX(PA.crossing) AS max_crossing
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS lost_matches
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY lost_matches ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010' AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010' AND overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'))

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_fifa_api_id = TA.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND TA.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

WITH AvgPass AS (
  SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_pass
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
    AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
JOIN AvgPass AP ON TA.buildUpPlayPassing > AP.avg_pass
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
GROUP BY T.team_long_name;

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name, AVG(PA.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
JOIN (SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) AS avg_passing FROM Team_Attributes) AS A
  ON TA.chanceCreationPassing < A.avg_passing
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers'

SELECT DISTINCT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy
FROM Player P

JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name
FROM member
JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member
GROUP BY member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(expense.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN (SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost FROM expense) a ON e.cost > a.avg_cost

SELECT m.major_name, m.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Garrett' AND mem.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary'

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;
SELECT zip_code.city FROM member JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T2.hero_id, T1.full_name
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name, superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS percentage_bad, SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;
SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND colour.colour = 'No Colour'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT c2.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT SUM(s1.weight_kg) - SUM(s2.weight_kg) AS weight_difference
FROM superhero s1
JOIN superhero s2
  ON s1.full_name = 'Emil Blonsky' AND s2.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.id = 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'Male';

SELECT SUM(gender.id = 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero AS s JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'

SELECT superhero.id
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT superhero.full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Alien'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg AS weight, r.race AS race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT s.id FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN (SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS avg_height FROM superhero) a
  ON s.height_cm > a.avg_height * 0.8
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_male_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_male_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'

SELECT P.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age_gap
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200;

SELECT L.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', P.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';
SELECT `aCL IgM` FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Description = '1994-02-19');

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12';
SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964 AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) AS avg_igm FROM Examination) AS a
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > a.avg_igm + a.avg_igm * 0.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT T1.Symptoms FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY T1.Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.Description, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p WHERE p.ID = 48473;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') / COUNT(Patient.SEX) * 100
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Patient.Birthday) = '1980' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'
SELECT DATEDIFF(T1.`Examination Date`, T2.`First Date`) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 821298
SELECT AVG(T2.LDH) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS P ON T1.ID = P.ID
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T2.ID = T1.ID AND T2.Date > T1.Date
WHERE T2.ID IS NULL
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
ORDER BY l.`T-CHO` DESC, p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l."U-PRO" > 0
  AND l."U-PRO" < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900 AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000 AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis <> 0 AND l.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(p.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.DNA < 8 AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.Date FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY T2.ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T2
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID
JOIN Patient AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '='

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule m;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c1 ON a.atom_id = c1.atom_id
LEFT JOIN connected c2 ON a.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id IS NULL AND c2.atom_id2 IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT a1.atom_id AS atom_id1, a1.element AS element1,
       a2.atom_id AS atom_id2, a2.element AS element2
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT a1.element AS element1,
           a2.element AS element2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(bond_count) / SUM(bond_count) AS percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000' OR molecule.molecule_id = 'TR001' OR molecule.molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    INNER JOIN customers c
        ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least_custs AS (
    SELECT ct.CustomerID,
           ct.Segment,
           ct.total_consumption
    FROM cust_totals ct
    INNER JOIN seg_min sm
        ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment
       AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           CAST(SUM(total_consumption) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM least_custs
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    sme.annual_avg - lam.annual_avg AS SME_minus_LAM,
    lam.annual_avg - kam.annual_avg AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    kam.annual_avg - sme.annual_avg AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') sme,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') lam,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') kam;

JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID
WHERE substr(transactions_1k.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND substr(transactions_1k.Date, 6, 2) = '06';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.CustomerID)
FROM customers
INNER JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND yearmonth.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT gasstations.Country
FROM transactions_1k
JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID
WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY transactions_1k.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT customers.Segment
FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE yearmonth.Date = (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM yearmonth)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT gasstations.Country
FROM transactions_1k
INNER JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID
WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-24' AND transactions_1k.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT customers.Currency
FROM transactions_1k
JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE transactions_1k.Date LIKE '201306%'
GROUP BY transactions_1k.CustomerID, customers.Currency
HAVING SUM(transactions_1k.Price) = 214582.17;

SELECT gasstations.Country
FROM transactions_1k
INNER JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID
WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-24' AND transactions_1k.Price = 548.4;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID)
   FROM transactions_1k t
   INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND c.Currency = 'EUR') * 100.0
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID)
   FROM transactions_1k
   WHERE Date = '2012-08-25') AS percentage;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(Amount * Price)
   FROM transactions_1k
   WHERE CustomerID = 38508) AS TotalSpentAtGasStations,
  (SELECT SUM(transactions_1k.Amount * transactions_1k.Price)
   FROM transactions_1k
   INNER JOIN yearmonth ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
   WHERE transactions_1k.CustomerID = 38508
     AND yearmonth.Date = '201201') AS Jan2012Spend;

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       c.Currency,
       t.total_price / t.total_amount AS avg_price_per_item
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(Price) AS total_price,
           SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'

                        FROM Player_Attributes
                        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
                        FROM Player_Attributes
                        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'

                                                FROM Player_Attributes

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'

      SELECT AVG(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team t2
      INNER JOIN Team_Attributes ta2 ON t2.team_api_id = ta2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', ta2.date) = '2012'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM loan
INNER JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND loan.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_1995,
       AVG(A13) AS avg_1996,
       CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district
INNER JOIN client ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A11 > 6000
  AND district.A11 < 10000
  AND client.gender = 'F';
SELECT COUNT(client.client_id) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000

SELECT
    account.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(district.A11) - MIN(district.A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY district.A11 ASC, client.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT loan.account_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration > 12
  AND loan.status = 'A'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', account.date) = '1993'
  AND loan.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND l2.status = 'A'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id

WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'

SELECT account.date

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card
INNER JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
INNER JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id

SELECT COUNT(account.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND account.date >= '1996-01-01'
  AND account.date <= '1996-12-31';

SELECT
    account.account_id,
    account.frequency,
    client.client_id,
    client.gender,
    client.birth_date
FROM account
INNER JOIN district
    ON account.district_id = district.district_id
INNER JOIN disp
    ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
INNER JOIN client
    ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND account.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY account.account_id;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date

SELECT district.A3
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY district.A3
ORDER BY SUM(loan.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

  out_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * in_count / out_count) AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, c.CustomerID AS cust, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY seg
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.seg, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.seg = m.seg AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT p.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100
     / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS percentage_difference
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT T2.Date, strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC, T2.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT E."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12';
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT strftime('%Y', l.Date) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date = '1991-10-21' AND l.UA = '8.4';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count, GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2."ANA Pattern" = 'S'
  AND T2."aCL IgM" > (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") FROM Examination) * 0.2
                     + (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") FROM Examination);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT T1.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY T1.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(SEX = 'F') AS REAL) / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT julianday(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - julianday(p."First Date") AS evaluation_delay_days
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.ALP < 300 AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALB,
       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "ALB Within Normal Range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID)
  AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5))

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN T1.ID END) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN T1.ID END)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC, P."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45 AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."U-PRO" > 0
  AND l."U-PRO" < 30
  AND p."Diagnosis" = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.RF AS REAL) < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '2' AND T3.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T2.SM IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH IS NOT NULL
      AND L.LDH != ''
      AND CAST(L.LDH AS REAL) < 500
    ORDER BY CAST(L.LDH AS REAL) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
)
AND ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
  AND T2."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX(T4."aCL IgA")
      FROM Examination AS T4
      JOIN Laboratory AS T5 ON T4.ID = T5.ID
      WHERE T5.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND e."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG < 200
    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS average_single_bonded
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(m.label) = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE TRIM(m.label) = '+' AND TRIM(b.bond_type) = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(t.cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
);
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
LIMIT 1;
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS cnt
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '+'
        GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND a.element = 'o';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` LIMIT 3
SELECT s.School FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 500 AND s.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT dname FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY dname ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100 AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
SELECT T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T1.cds HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`Low Grade` = 9 AND T1.`High Grade` = 12

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded' AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally Funded')

SELECT (SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) + (SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 10)
SELECT T2."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / T2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk z
    JOIN mins m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, restricted to customers paying in CZK
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312   -- year 2013
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment (SME / LAM / KAM)
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = (total consumption of the lowest-consumption customers)
    --                / (count of those customers), per segment
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

      m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.date                              AS loan_issued,
    l.amount                            AS loan_amount,
    l.duration                          AS duration_months,
    l.payments                          AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Finished - no payment problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in debt'
    END                                 AS payment_status,
    COALESCE(p.n_payments, 0)           AS payments_made_so_far,
    l.amount - COALESCE(p.n_payments, 0) * l.payments AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l  ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS n_payments
    FROM trans
    WHERE k_symbol = 'UROK'             -- 'UROK' = loan payment transactions
    GROUP BY account_id
) p ON p.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- One row per bond: the (unordered) pair of elements of its two atoms
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a.element) AS elem1,
           MAX(a.element) AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
    GROUP BY c.bond_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Number of bonds per element combination
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
),
max_combo AS (
    -- Frequency of the most common combination
    SELECT MAX(num_bonds) AS max_bonds
    FROM combo_counts
)
SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 *
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cc.num_bonds), 0)
          FROM combo_counts cc
          CROSS JOIN max_combo m
          WHERE cc.num_bonds = m.max_bonds)
         /
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond_elements),
       2) AS pct_of_bonds;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH t AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312  c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
m AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM t
    GROUP BY Segment
),
a AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM t
    JOIN m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH ap AS (
  SELECT m.country_id AS country_id, m.home_player_1 AS pid FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_2 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_3 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_4 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_5 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_6 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_7 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_8 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_9 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_10 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_11 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_1 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_2 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_3 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_4 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_5 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_6 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_7 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_8 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_9 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_10 FROM Match m
  UNION ALL SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_11 FROM Match m
),
pc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_id, pid FROM ap WHERE pid IS NOT NULL
),
avgw AS (
  SELECT c.name AS country, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
  FROM pc
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pc.pid
  JOIN Country c ON c.id = pc.country_id
  GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT country
FROM avgw
WHERE avg_weight = (SELECT MAX(avg_weight) FROM avgw)

WITH oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),
low_sal AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.A11) AS min_sal
    FROM oldest_female o
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = o.district_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT min_sal FROM low_sal) AS gap
FROM oldest_female o
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = o.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = o.district_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT min_sal FROM low_sal);

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'SME' THEN a.AvgConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'LAM' THEN a.AvgConsumption END) AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'LAM' THEN a.AvgConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'KAM' THEN a.AvgConsumption END) AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'KAM' THEN a.AvgConsumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'SME' THEN a.AvgConsumption END) AS Diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           1.0 * SUM(t.Total) / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM (
        SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS Total
        FROM yearmonth y
        INNER JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
          AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
        GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
    ) t
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT g.Segment, MIN(g.Total) AS MinTotal
        FROM (
            SELECT y2.CustomerID, c2.Segment, SUM(y2.Consumption) AS Total
            FROM yearmonth y2
            INNER JOIN customers c2 ON y2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
            WHERE y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
              AND c2.Currency = 'CZK'
            GROUP BY y2.CustomerID, c2.Segment
        ) g
        GROUP BY g.Segment
    ) m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.Total = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
) a
