INNER JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG < 200
ORDER BY l.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
INNER JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule m;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule m;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_type
LIMIT 2

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.atom_id IS NULL;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
INNER JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected AS c
INNER JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id), 5) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_percentage
FROM bond b
INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM bond AS b
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
INNER JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
INNER JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(a.element)
FROM atom a
INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT T1.molecule_id, T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'ca';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond
   WHERE bond_type = ' = '
     AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR006')) AS double_bond_count,
  (SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END
   FROM molecule
   WHERE label = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic_status;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 's'
LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE a.atom_id IS NULL AND b.bond_id IS NULL;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
INNER JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM bond b
INNER JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
INNER JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS cnt
        FROM molecule m2
        INNER JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY m2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
INNER JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT satscores.dname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY satscores.dname
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda' AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T1.School, T1.FundingType
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T1.CDSCode, T1.School, T1.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T2.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T2.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT schools.School, schools.Street, schools.City, schools.State, schools.Zip
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND frpm."Low Grade" <= '9'
  AND frpm."High Grade" >= '12'
  AND frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM (SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)`, `Enrollment (K-12)`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS rnk FROM frpm) AS t WHERE rnk IN (10, 11)

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', sch.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)

SELECT frpm.`School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = '31'
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  )
SELECT Street, School FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND schools.CDSCode IN (SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite >= 1500)

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.School)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.Charter = 0
  AND T1.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' AND SOC = '11' AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT frpm.`School Name`, frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND frpm.`High Grade` = '9' AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT schools.City, schools.School, frpm.`Low Grade`
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY schools.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 'Schools with magnet K-8 and Multiple Provision Types' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
  AND schools.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
UNION ALL
SELECT City, COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE GSoffered = 'K-8'
  AND City IN (SELECT DISTINCT City FROM schools WHERE GSserved = 'K-8')
GROUP BY City

SELECT frpm.`District Code`, frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR schools.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = '62'
  AND DOC = 54
  AND ((AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmEmail1) <> '')
    OR (AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmEmail2) <> '')
    OR (AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmEmail3) <> ''))
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users)
SELECT Title FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')
SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName
FROM users
JOIN posts ON users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId
WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
SELECT p.Body FROM posts p JOIN tags t ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011'
SELECT AVG(Score) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910)

SELECT comments.Text
FROM comments
JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id
WHERE posts.ParentId = 107829 AND posts.CommentCount = 1
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM comments WHERE Text = 'thank you user93!')
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBounty
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%'

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE Id IN (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM votes
    WHERE BountyAmount = 50
      AND PostId IN (
          SELECT Id
          FROM posts
          WHERE Title LIKE '%variance%'
      )
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%' AND u.Id IN (SELECT b.UserId FROM badges b WHERE b.Name = 'Teacher') AND u.Id IN (SELECT b.UserId FROM badges b WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter')

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN users u ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
  AND ph.PostId IN (
      SELECT PostId
      FROM postHistory
      GROUP BY PostId
      HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  )

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id = (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
    ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT ph.PostHistoryTypeId, c.UniqueCommenters
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PostHistoryTypeId FROM postHistory WHERE PostId = 3720) ph
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS UniqueCommenters FROM comments WHERE PostId = 3720 AND UserId IS NOT NULL) c
SELECT p.Score, pl.LinkTypeId FROM posts p JOIN postLinks pl ON p.Id = pl.PostId WHERE p.Id = 395

FROM (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(OwnerUserId) > 10
) p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Announcer'
SELECT Date FROM badges WHERE UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Location = 'Rochester, NY')
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teacher') * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM badges) AS percentage
SELECT comments.Text FROM comments JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id WHERE posts.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33'

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';
SELECT Name FROM badges WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Sharpie')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010'

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS votes_2010_to_2011_ratio
FROM votes

SELECT p.Tags
FROM posts p
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'John Salvatier')

FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
)
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY TotalViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId)
FROM badges b
WHERE b.Name = 'Commentator'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2010-07-21 23:59:59'
SELECT DisplayName, Age FROM users WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users)

SELECT LastEditDate, LastEditorUserId
FROM posts
WHERE Title = 'Detecting a given face in a database of facial images'
SELECT b.Name FROM badges AS b JOIN users AS u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%' AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011'
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.WebsiteUrl FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId WHERE p.FavoriteCount > 150

SELECT COUNT(postHistory.Id) AS post_history_count, posts.LastEditDate
FROM posts
JOIN postHistory ON postHistory.PostId = posts.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY posts.LastEditDate;

SELECT u.LastAccessDate, u.Location
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT p.Id AS PostId, b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2013'
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2013'
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Samuel'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000
SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts)
SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM users)

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Name) AS badge_count
    FROM badges
    GROUP BY UserId
) b ON u.Id = b.UserId

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt
      ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.total_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH czk_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, along with their segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption in each segment
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consuming customers
    --                 / number of those customers (per segment)
    SELECT
        t.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN segment_min m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment
     AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    FROM oldest_females o
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = o.district_id

       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - l.min_salary AS gap

FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2)
        FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY E.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(E.Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID, 
       T2.ALP < 300 AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    Patient.ID,
    Laboratory.Date,
    Laboratory.TP,
    Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T2.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range' 
        ELSE 'Not within normal range' 
    END AS 'Albumin Status'
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T3.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM (
    SELECT T1.ID,
           T1.SEX,
           T2.UA,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.ID ORDER BY T2.Date DESC) AS rnk
    FROM Patient AS T1
    JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
) AS T3
WHERE T3.rnk = 1
  AND ((T3.SEX = 'M' AND T3.UA < 8.0)
    OR (T3.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS result
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT T.ID, T.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T
JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID
WHERE T.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
    FROM Laboratory
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS NUM_PATIENTS
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900
  AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS FirstDate
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.LDH AS REAL) < 500          -- LDH in the normal range
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(L.LDH AS REAL)) DESC   -- pick the patient with the highest LDH
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1.`aCL IgA` = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`)
      FROM Examination AS T3
      INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
      WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) 
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id 
    OR T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id2
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Not Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id   AS atom1_id,
       a1.element   AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id   AS atom2_id,
       a2.element   AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type   = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS element_pairs;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS result
FROM connected AS cn
JOIN atom AS a1 ON cn.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON cn.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE cn.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ( (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl') );

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM   atom a
JOIN   molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE  m.label = '+'                      -- carcinogenic molecules only
  AND  SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'      -- restrict to the 4th atom
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT 
    T1.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type) AS number_of_bond_types
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 
    ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T1.label = '-'

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND schools.County = 'Alameda' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM schools AS T2 INNER JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School, T2.FundingType HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND s.County = 'Monterey'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.School, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T4.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T4.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM schools AS T3
      INNER JOIN frpm AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T3.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
SELECT schools.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.City = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School FROM schools AS T2 INNER JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`Enrollment (K-12)`) FROM frpm)
SELECT sname, MailStreet FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE ((AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')) AND ((AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez'))
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND City = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Charter = 0
    AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
    AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" * 100 FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND f."Low Grade" = 'K' AND f."High Grade" = '9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.City, T1.School, T2.`Low Grade` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.State = 'CA' ORDER BY T1.Latitude ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
           AVG(y.Consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date LIKE '2013%' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
least_per_segment AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, z.annual_avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN (
        SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
        FROM czk_2013
        WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        GROUP BY Segment
    ) m ON m.Segment = z.Segment AND m.min_total = z.total_consumption
)
SELECT pairs.pair, pairs.consumption_difference
FROM (
    SELECT 'SME vs LAM' AS pair,
           (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM least_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
           (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM least_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS consumption_difference
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'LAM vs KAM',
           (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM least_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
           (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM least_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'KAM vs SME',

           (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM least_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
) pairs

SELECT p.ID, strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(e.LAC) LIKE '%positive%'

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5

SELECT MAX(2024 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(2024 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG IS NOT NULL AND Laboratory.TG < 150

SELECT t.LabDate,
       CAST((julianday(t.[First Date]) - julianday(t.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS AgeAtFirstVisit
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, p.[First Date], MIN(l.Date) AS LabDate
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Description LIKE '%SJS%'
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday, p.[First Date]
    ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
    LIMIT 1
) t

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL AND (l.UA < 3.5 OR l.UA > 7.2)
)

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) = 1991
  AND CAST(strftime('%m', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) = 10
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 1999

SELECT T2.`aCL IgG`, T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1994-02-19' AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) = 1994 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = 9 AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1992'

SELECT CAST((JULIANDAY('1991-10-21') - JULIANDAY(T1.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INT) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = '1991-10-21' AND T2.UA = 8.4
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE Description LIKE '1997-01-27%'

SELECT COUNT(*) OVER () AS num_patients, ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination)

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP = '2+'
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123

SELECT E.Symptoms FROM Examination AS E JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID WHERE P.Description = 'SLE' GROUP BY E.Symptoms HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination AS E2 JOIN Patient AS P2 ON E2.ID = P2.ID WHERE P2.Description = 'SLE' GROUP BY E2.Symptoms) AS t)
SELECT `First Date`, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND P.Description LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND P.Admission IS NULL
SELECT JULIANDAY(`Admission`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS days_to_evaluation FROM Patient WHERE ID = 821298
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH BETWEEN 120 AND 246

SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALP BETWEEN 38 AND 126 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS ALP_Normal
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT SUM(L.TP - 80) AS total_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 80
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.* FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.ALB NOT BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.2 ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.2 THEN 'Within normal range' ELSE 'Not within normal range' END FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T3.UA) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN (SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID AND T3.Date = T2.LatestDate WHERE T3.UA BETWEEN 3.4 AND 7.4

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN BETWEEN 6 AND 20

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE L.CRE < 0.4 OR L.CRE > 1.4
) T
SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX, SUM(L.`T-BIL`) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.`T-BIL` NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 21 GROUP BY P.SEX

SELECT P."ID", TOTAL(L."T-CHO") AS "T-CHO index"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L."ID" = P."ID"
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
GROUP BY P."ID"
HAVING MIN(P."Birthday") = (
    SELECT MIN(P2."Birthday")
    FROM Patient AS P2
    JOIN Laboratory AS L2 ON L2."ID" = P2."ID"
    WHERE L2."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.APTT > 38 AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 200 OR L.FG > 400)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Description FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 1

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory."U-PRO" IN ('-', 'neg')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.`Date`) = '2000' AND T2.IGG > 1560
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '2000' AND T2.`aCL IgG` <= 20 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.CRP > 0.3 AND l.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.CRE < 0.6 OR T2.CRE > 1.2) AND (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND T2.PT > 14
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF = 'NEGATIVE' AND (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1 AND T3.C4 BETWEEN 16 AND 38
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE SM = 0 AND Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T3.SC170 = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 = 0
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient."First Date" < '2000-01-01' AND Laboratory.SSA = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE T1.DNA <= 61 AND T1.ID NOT IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Examination AS T2)

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT > 40) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT > 40 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT MAX(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT < 8 OR GOT > 40)

SELECT MIN(T2."First Date")
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.LDH BETWEEN 120 AND 230
  AND T1.LDH = (SELECT MAX(T3.LDH) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.LDH BETWEEN 120 AND 230)
SELECT T1.`Examination Date` FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.2)

SELECT TOTAL(patient_count) AS male_normal_alb_tp
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
      AND L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5
      AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0
    GROUP BY P.ID
)
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.2

SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE BETWEEN 0.4 AND 1.4 AND T3."aCL IgG" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgG") FROM Examination)

SELECT TOTAL(1)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
    FROM Examination AS E
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
    WHERE E.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
      AND L.`T-BIL` > 1.2
) AS T
SELECT Description FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG = (SELECT max(TG) FROM Laboratory WHERE TG BETWEEN 30 AND 150))
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type HAVING count(*) = (SELECT max(cnt) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type) AS t)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(b.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY atom.element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3) FROM molecule

SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR004'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c)

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT atom_id2 AS atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')
UNION
SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')

SELECT MAX(combination_count) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 5) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_percentage FROM bond JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'chlorine' AND a2.element = 'carbon')
    OR (a1.element = 'carbon' AND a2.element = 'chlorine'))

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 4
  AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'ca'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'carbon' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '='
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'cl'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = 'double'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(t.cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) t
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '2'
  AND (LOWER(a1.element) = 'o' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'o')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.CDSCode
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;
SELECT FundingType FROM schools WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT cds FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Riverside' GROUP BY cds HAVING SUM(AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400)

SELECT School, Street, City, State, Zip
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Monterey'
      AND "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
);

SELECT schools.School, schools.DOCType
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
) avg_t
ON (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > avg_t.avg_diff
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded';

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT sc.AdmEmail1
FROM schools sc
JOIN frpm f ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.sname, schools.MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'SME' THEN a.avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'LAM' THEN a.avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'LAM' THEN a.avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'KAM' THEN a.avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'KAM' THEN a.avg_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN a.Segment = 'SME' THEN a.avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
    SELECT x.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(x.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(x.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM (
        SELECT ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
               c.Segment AS Segment,
               SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
        FROM yearmonth ym
        JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
    ) x
    JOIN (
        SELECT c2.Segment AS Segment,
               MIN(t.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
        FROM (
            SELECT ym2.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
                   SUM(ym2.Consumption) AS total_consumption
            FROM yearmonth ym2
            JOIN customers c3 ON ym2.CustomerID = c3.CustomerID
            WHERE c3.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND ym2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            GROUP BY ym2.CustomerID
        ) t
        JOIN customers c2 ON t.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
        GROUP BY c2.Segment
    ) m
      ON x.Segment = m.Segment
     AND x.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY x.Segment
) a;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           MIN(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN segment_min sm
      ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS "SME - LAM",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS "LAM - KAM",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS "KAM - SME"
FROM segment_avgs;

    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

            SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
            FROM yearmonth AS T3
            JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
            WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T1.Consumption = (
            SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
            FROM yearmonth AS T3
            JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
            WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  ) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T1.Consumption = (
            SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
            FROM yearmonth AS T3
            JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
            WHERE T4.Segment = 'LAM' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND T1.Consumption = (
            SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
            FROM yearmonth AS T3
            JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
            WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  ) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (
    SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK'

            JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
            WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK'

JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T3.link_to_event
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member
WHERE T2.approved = 'true'
  AND T2.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'education' 
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services' 
  AND member.position = 'Member';
SELECT expense_description FROM expense GROUP BY expense_description HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id
ORDER BY SUM(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT z.city FROM member m JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT p.SEX, l.UA,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
) AS T
WHERE T.rn = 1
  AND ((T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0) OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5));
